name: Legash Sprint 1 Wire Contract
description: Single source of truth for the Sprint 1 wire format, copied from the shipped Backend/ code. The Backend is the authority; the Postman collection and the mock server must reproduce this exactly. Use scripts/check-contract.js to enforce it.

shape.message: Hospital registered successfully. Please verify your email.

400.note: Joi validation failure. Uses `message` key (not `error`) for this endpoint.

shape.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

500.note: Duplicate email/licenseNumber currently surfaces here (E11000 not mapped to 409).

shape.message: Email verified successfully. You can now log in once approved by the admin.
Invalid verification link or hospital not found.

200.note: FLAT envelope. NO data wrapper, NO hospitalId. role is 'hospital' when a Hospital matches, 'superadmin' when SuperAdmin matches.

shape.error: Please verify your email before logging in. | Invalid email or password.

envelope.success: flat envelope: { success, ... }, no data/statusCode/requestId/timestamp wrapper
envelope.error: flat error envelope: { success: false, error: 'message' } (or { success: false, message } on hospital register validation)

driftPolicy: The Backend is frozen. If any shape changes, update THIS file, the Postman collection, and the mock together in the same commit. The check-contract script fails CI when backend routes drift from the paths below.
